newsitem.title: CHINA: China buys 54.65 million tonnes of autumn grain.
newsitem.headline: China buys 54.65 million tonnes of autumn grain.

text.p: China's state purchases of autumn grain have reached 54.65 million tonnes, completing 60.8 percent of the target, the China Daily said on Thursday.
Grain purchases had started well because the purchase price had been set above free market prices, the newspaper said. It gave no details.
More than 45 million hectares (111 million acres) of farmland had so far been planted with winter crops, nearly completing the season's sowing, it said.
Official forecasts say China's summer grain harvest next year will be around 112 million tonnes.
China is expected to reap a record 480 million tonnes of grain this year, up from last year's harvest of about 465 million tonnes.
